# Papa Johns The Works Pizza: Seven Premium Toppings in One Perfect Bite


September 23, 2026 10:00 am EDT[Download as PDF](https://ir.papajohns.com/_assets/_e482f1e70df83385fcc029b7960f78a1/papajohns/news/2026-09-23_Papa_Johns_The_Works_Pizza_Seven_Premium_Toppings__678.pdf)


*From game days to cozy nights in, this fan-favorite pizza is made for sharing, with a flavor combination you just know will hit the spot*


ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Why settle for one favorite topping when you can have seven? This fall, Papa Johns is putting one of its most beloved Handcrafted Specialty Pizzas in the spotlight: The Works, a fan-favorite loaded with seven premium toppings that come together in one craveable, flavor-packed bite.


This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:[https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260923616600/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260923616600/en/)


Papa Johns The Works Pizza


From game-day watch parties and movie marathons to impromptu hangs with friends, fall is made for gathering around the table. And when the group wants a pizza that brings something for everyone, The Works comes fully loaded and ready to deliver.


The Works is stacked with pepperoni, julienne-cut Canadian bacon, spicy Italian sausage, onions, green peppers, mushrooms and black olives, creating a savory, satisfying combination with something to love in every slice. The pizza starts with Papa Johns fresh, never frozen original dough, made with just six simple ingredients, and is finished with real cheese made from mozzarella layered over the toppings to help seal in flavor.


"The Works has earned its fan-favorite status because it's more than a loaded pizza. It's a masterclass in abundance and balance," said Mark Gabrovic, Vice President of Culinary Innovation at Papa Johns. “Each of the seven premium toppings was carefully selected because of how they complement the others. From the savory richness of the meats to the freshness of the vegetables, every ingredient has a purpose, delivering the kind of flavor experience that keeps fans coming back. When the right ingredients come together, you don't have to think twice. You know it works from the first bite."


The Works is part of Papa Johns Handcrafted Specialty Pizza lineup, a collection of expertly curated pizzas designed to take the guesswork out of choosing toppings. Rather than building a pizza from scratch, fans can dig into combinations thoughtfully crafted to bring complementary flavors together - all in one pizza.


For a limited time, The Works is available starting at $10.99 for a medium and $13.99 for a large. For more information or to order, visit[PapaJohns.com](https://www.papajohns.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) or the Papa Johns app.


**ABOUT PAPA JOHNS**


Papa John’s International, Inc. (Nasdaq: PZZA) opened its doors in 1984 with one goal in mind: BETTER INGREDIENTS. BETTER PIZZA.® Papa Johns believes that using high-quality ingredients leads to superior quality pizzas. Its original dough is made of only six ingredients and is fresh, never frozen. Papa Johns tops its pizzas with real cheese made from mozzarella, pizza sauce made with vine-ripened tomatoes that go from vine to can in the same day and meat free of fillers. It was the first national pizza delivery chain to announce the removal of artificial flavors and synthetic colors from its entire food menu. Papa Johns is co-headquartered in Atlanta, Ga. and Louisville, Ky. and is the world’s third-largest pizza delivery company with approximately 6,000 restaurants in approximately 50 countries and territories. For more information about the Company or to order pizza online, visit[www.papajohns.com](http://www.papajohns.com/) or download the Papa Johns mobile app for iOS or Android.
